segments.name: Medical Devices
products: precision machined parts and assemblies for the aerospace and defense industries
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and repairs autoclavable, battery-powered and electric multi-function surgical devices, primarily for medical device OEMs and distributors.
segments.evidence: We have only one operating segment as our business is currently operated.

revenueModel.text: Medical device OEMs and distributors pay the company under development and supply agreements for custom-designed surgical devices, contract manufacturing, repairs, and NRE services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our medical device products are sold primarily to original equipment manufacturers and our air motors are sold to a wide range of distributors and end users.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the company acquired Advanced Precision Machining, LLC, adding precision machined parts and assemblies for the aerospace and defense industries.
changes.evidence: In February 2026, we acquired APM, a manufacturer located in Costa Mesa, California.
